originals.why: Open-subject fragment ('… oedd yn mynd i fod yn barod'). It is grammatical North Welsh after a fronted subject, and barod means ready, the sense this course teaches.
Same fragment with heddiw added. Natural, and barod means ready.
'fod o wedi bod yn barod' is natural North Welsh for 'that it had been ready'. Here barod means ready, not 'already', so it fits this LEGO's sense.
